title: 专家解读｜深化生成合成内容标识治理，完善人工智能技术安全体系

policy_extraction.issuing_body: 国家互联网信息办公室 (Cyberspace Administration of China)

evidence.quote: 明确了隐式标识的技术实现方式，通过元数据标识为安全追溯提供了可靠保障
明确了元数据隐式标识的字段要素，在尽量不影响元数据处理和传输的前提下，嵌入必要字段，记录生成合成内容的关键信息和关键环节
通过清晰、透明的内容标识，用户能够清楚识别人工智能生成的内容，一方面提高了信息透明度，增强了用户的知情权和选择权
明确了文本、图像、音频、视频等多模态的标识要求，将安全治理深入到内容模态层面
创新性地将传播平台纳入监管范畴，实现从生成到传播的全链条治理
有效督促人工智能生成合成服务提供者及传播平台落实企业责任

policy_extraction.implementation_notes: This is an expert interpretation article published by CAC accompanying the '人工智能生成合成内容标识办法' (AI-Generated Content Labeling Measures) and companion national mandatory standard. The document itself is commentary/guidance rather than the primary regulatory instrument. It references mandatory labeling requirements for AI-generated content across modalities (text, image, audio, video) including both explicit (visible) and implicit (metadata) labeling. Binding force derives from the underlying '标识办法' which is described as a mandatory standard.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: The document frames AI governance around preventing misinformation, technical abuse, and protecting network ecosystem security—core social stability concerns. It emphasizes content labeling to maintain information order, user awareness, and traceable/trustworthy AI. Secondary frames include consumer/public safety (user rights, transparency) and innovation enablement (balancing regulation with industry development).

evidence_spans.quote: 人工智能技术带来的虚假信息、技术滥用风险逐渐显露，给网络生态安全带来了新的风险挑战

在保护创新活力与维护公共利益之间找到平衡点
